d:
Official video for D.C. based singer and songwriter Vidya’s 2015 cover of Sam Smith's billboard smash hit "Lay Me Down" and "Ennodu Nee Irundhaal" by A.R. Rahman and Sid Sriram, from the movie "I".
Vidya Vox Bookings:
Hey guys! New mashup, two songs I have been loving recently. "Lay Me Down" by Sam Smith & "Ennodu Nee Irundhaal" by A.R. Rahman​. Happy listening :)

Original song credits:
"Lay Me Down," Sam Smith, In The Lonely Hour
"Ennodu Nee Irundhall," A.R. Rahman, Sid Sriram, from the movie "I"
